name: Global video streaming and CDN / Define the success contract

intent.outcome: Design an adaptive bitrate video streaming service delivering high-throughput playback globally.
intent.users: Callers, state owners and operators named by the problem.
intent.constraints: Make ordering, durability, capacity and retry assumptions explicit. Synthetic segmented delivery with two advertised rendition sizes and a transfer-time adaptation rule; manifests stand in for pre-encoded assets. No actual encoding, DRM, codecs or Netflix production implementation.
intent.success: An observable request path, bounded waiting, visible failures and a justified recovery policy.

concepts.label: Users and requests
concepts.responsibility: Who issues requests, and which identities or deadlines travel with them?

concepts.label: System responsibility
concepts.responsibility: Design an adaptive bitrate video streaming service delivering high-throughput playback globally.
